I wrote `component.html` in the folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout and spacing are unchecked.

The screen is 1280px wide inside `#component`, with the exact content you gave. It uses only the colors, type sizes and spacing from `DESIGN.md`. Each section has its heading in columns 1–4 and a card in columns 5–12, on the 12-column grid.

- **Fonts:** Unbounded and Archivo aren't available, since there are no font files or links in the folder. The page falls back to Arial and system fonts, so the headings will look different from the spec.
- **Switches:** I set "Email me…" and "Weekly summary" to on and "Product updates" to off. You didn't specify the states.
- **Delete Workspace:** The palette has no red, so this is a quiet button with an ink outline, and the Danger zone card has an ink border.
- **Notifications legend:** I added a visually hidden "Notifications" legend so the switch group has a name for screen readers. That's extra text in the markup, though it isn't visible.
